27/05/2023, 14:09 - +91 98202 51220: The MRI is the gold standard but it is rarely used for this purpose.

The silver standard is the DEXA body composition scan. As far as I know it is done in only one place in India - in Mumbai at the Reset Gym. But it has its limitations as it records fat inside organs and glycogen stores in muscles as muscle mass. If you lose organ fat or glycogen stores in the liver, it is recorded as a decrease in muscle mass.

Then there are bio impedance scales like Renpho which are far cheaper and can be used at home on a daily basis. The Renpho's results are similar to a DEXA scan. But it has the same issues as a DEXA scan.

You can also measure and track your waist (your waist to height ratio is an important indicator of fatty liver and insulin resistance and also your waist to hips ratio which is an indicator of your central obesity and an indicator of insulin resistance and cardiovascular diseases). You can also measure and track your chest, hips, thighs, arms, neck, calves, ankles etc.

*Carbohydrate Intakes below Recommendations with a High Intake of Fat Are associated with Higher Prevalence of Metabolic Syndrome*

*Abstract* This study found that a carbohydrate intake <45% of energy was associated with greater odds of prevalent MetS compared with a recommended carbohydrate intake. 18/07/2023, 19:25 - +91 96072 01220: The DIY stomach acid test,


1. Mix ¼ tsp of baking soda in 120-170 ml of cold water, first thing in the morning before eating or drinking anything. 
2. Drink the baking soda solution.
3. Note the time it takes for a burp or belch to come about. Wait up to 5 minutes. 
4. Wait for 10 to 15 mins & notice if & when you begin to belch (& how big those belches are)

Frequency of the test: Recommended performing this test on 3 consecutive mornings to find an overall average. 

Results:
-> Sufficient Stomach Acid-> Lots of belching equivalent to drinking a highly carbonated soda.
-> Low Stomach Acid-> No belching to 1 or 2 small burps within 5 minutes.

However, it is important not to confuse these with small little burps from swallowing air when drinking the solution. Any belching after 3 minutes is an indication of low stomach acid production.

काले गेहूं के फायदे

1. दिल के रोगों दूर के लिए फायदेमंद :
काले गेहूं का सेवन करने से दिल की बीमारियों के होने का खतरा कम होता है, क्योंकि काले गेहूं में ट्राइग्लिसराइड तत्व मौजूद होते हैं, इसके अलावा काले गेहूं में मौजूद मैग्नीशियम उच्च मात्रा में पाया जाता है जिससे शरीर में कोलेस्ट्राल का स्तर को सामान्य बनाए रखने में मदद मिलती है।

2. डायबिटीज के रोगियों के लिए फायदेमंद :
डायबिटीज के मरीज अगर काले गेहूं की रोटी खाते हैं तो उनके खून में शुगर का स्तर सही हो जाता है और ऐसा होने पर डायबिटीज नियंत्रित हो जाती है। इसके अलावा जो लोग रोजाना ये रोटी खाते हैं उन्हें डायबिटीज होने का खतरा बेहद ही कम होता है और इस रोग से उनकी रक्षा होती है।

3. कब्ज से राहत दिलाने में फायदेमंद :
काले गेहूं की रोटी पाचन तंत्र के लिए फायदेमंद मानी जाती है, और काली रोटी खाने से पाचन तंत्र से संबंधित कई बीमारियां ठीक हो जाती हैं। इसलिए, कब्ज से पीड़ित लोगों को अपने आहार में काली रोटी को शामिल करना चाहिए और इस रोटी को रोजाना खाना चाहिए।

4. तनाव से बचाव के लिए फायदेमंद :
काला गेहूं तनाव जैसी इस भयानक बीमारी को समाप्त करने के लिए एक आशा की किरण लेकर आया है। शोध से यह पता चला है की तनाव से पीड़ित व्यक्ति पर इसके प्रयोग के बहुत ही सकारात्मक परिणाम पाये गये हैं।

5. एनीमिया के लिए फायदेमंद :
काले गेहूं में प्रोटीन, मैग्नीशियम के अलावा आयरन भी भरपूर मात्रा में पाया जाता है । ऐसे में अगर आप रोजाना काले गेहूं का सेवन करते हैं, तो शरीर में रक्त की कमी यानि एनिमिया की बीमारी को दूर किया जा सकता है। इससे शरीर में आक्सीजन का स्तर सही रहता है।

Kafka told her to meet him there the next day and they would come back to look for her.

The next day, when they had not yet found the doll, Kafka gave the girl a letter "written" by the doll saying "please don't cry. I took a trip to see the world. I will write to you about my adventures."

Thus began a story which continued until the end of Kafka's life.

During their meetings, Kafka read the letters of the doll carefully written with adventures and conversations that the girl found adorable.

Finally, Kafka brought back the doll (he bought one) that had returned to Berlin.

"It doesn't look like my doll at all," said the girl.

Kafka handed her another letter in which the doll wrote: "my travels have changed me." The little girl hugged the new doll and brought the doll with her to her happy home.

A year later Kafka died.

Many years later, the now-adult girl found a letter inside the doll. In the tiny letter signed by Kafka it was written:

"Everything you love will probably be lost, but in the end, love will return in another way."

Since the 1950s, when plastic became a part of nearly every aspect of life, corporations have tried to get consumers to take responsibility for the resulting pollution. It’s called “blame-shifting.” 

Instead of changing manufacturing laws, you get individuals to think that saving the environment is simply about recycling the cans in their kitchen. 

The strategy works because most people would rather have the illusion of personal control than stand up to powerful and complex forces.

The mind is a lot like a corporation that blame-shifts. 

Every day, we think tens of thousands of thoughts, most of which are negative and almost all of which are repetitive. 

The corrosive effect of our unskillful thinking on our emotional and physical health is well-known and well-documented. Yet, the mind still grasps at external solutions: more vitamins, exercise, ice baths. 

Like recycling, these solutions CAN be somewhat helpful. But, how will an hour of yoga or running compete with another 23 hours of self-hatred, self-comparison, and self-doubt? It’s an issue of scale.

The Dhammapada (a collection of sayings of the Buddha) says that the mind precedes all phenomena. At some point, you have to stop looking outside and look at the way your mind shapes experience. 

You aren’t angry because of what that person said; you’re angry because your mind is conditioned is to be angry. 

You aren’t sad because you have a bad diet; you’re sad because your mind is conditioned is to be sad. 

As the Buddha said, you’ll not find a worse enemy than an untrained mind, nor a better friend than a trained one.

When I’m upset, I like to ask: “What’s the real problem here?” 

Is it, in fact, what’s happening outside, or is it that my mind is clinging to something? 

Maybe it’s stuck on an idea of how things should be, or a resentment it’s trying to feed on. 

The mind often doesn’t know better: it looks for happiness where there isn’t any. 

But we can teach it better. And that’s how real change happens.

Adverse reactions to vaccines may be viewed as a result of the interaction between susceptibility of the vaccinated subject and various vaccine components. Among the implicated mechanisms for these reactions is molecular mimicry. 18/08/2023, 15:58 - +91 99620 99222: Folate plays critical roles in methylation. By donating its methyl groups, folate regulates DNA expression and much more. Without sufficient bioavailable folate, your cells cannot effectively express your genes.†

The MTHFR gene converts food folates into methyl folates. However, MTHFR variations and environmental or lifestyle stress can slow this gene down. If the MTHFR gene is slowed, MTHFR enzyme function is also slowed. The result can be a debilitating folate deficiency.

The artificial version of folate, folic acid, is often prescribed to folate-deficient individuals. Supplementation with L-5-MTHF may be more effective than folic acid supplementation at increasing blood folate levels.†

Folic acid- This artificial version of folate is not well-utilized by the body and can produce adverse effects. Folic acid must go through several enzymatic steps before it is converted into usable methylfolate. Its inefficient chemical structure may even slow down your SLC191A, DHFR, and MTHFR genes to the point of folate deficiency! Folic acid can also block usable folate from entering your cells, further contributing to folate deficiency.†

By supplementing with the natural form of folate as L-5-MTHF, you bypass the MTHFR enzyme. The methylated form, L-5-methylfolate (L-5-MTHF), requires no additional metabolic steps to be used by the body. This is why it is often the preferred choice for those with folate absorption or metabolic defects.†

L-5-MTHF also supports the production of important mood neurotransmitters. These include dopamine, serotonin, melatonin, epinephrine, and norepinephrine. Early on in both the serotonin and dopamine pathways, BH4 (tetrahydrobiopterin) is used as an essential cofactor. Research has indicated that higher strengths of L-5-MTHF can act both as a precursor for BH4 and also as an antioxidant that can regenerate BH4. By doing this, 5-MTHF supports the production of serotonin and its downstream metabolite serotonin as well as dopamine and its downstream metabolites epinephrine and norepinephrine. This is how supplementation with L-5-MTHF can help to support a healthy mood, focus, and sleep.†

DIRT ROAD DISCUSSIONS

PARASITES & BACTERIA

99% of all illness and disease in the human body is caused by parasitic worms and bad bacteria. Specifically, 96% by parasites and 3% by bacteria. 

These parasitic and bacterial microorganisms are constantly releasing tiny amounts of poison known as endotoxins into the human circulatory system, which the body then transports to the appropriate organ, either the liver, kidneys, skin or respiratory tract, where they are processed and expelled from the body.

IVERMECTIN

Ivermectin is a broad spectrum antiparasitic medicine derived from Avermectin, which is produced by the fermentation of soil dwelling streptomyces bacterial mold found in dirt. 

Ivermectin kills all parasites and bacteria, and is able to cross the blood brain barrier. 

Taking Ivermectin, rapidly increases the destruction of parasites and bacteria, which causes a much greater release of endotoxins (for this reason do not use if you are trying to get pregnant, are pregnant, or nursing). 

When this occurs, the increased toxicity triggers an acute immune response known as Herxheimers, which may cause a temporary worsening of current symptoms and/or the development of new symptoms.

HERXHEIMERS

Most people have experienced some form of Herxheimer reactions from taking antibiotics, and penicillin which also destroy parasites and bacteria. They just didn’t know it had a name. 

The severity of Herxheimer symptoms experienced from taking Ivermectin, will be directly related to your individual parasite load and the degree of inflammation triggered by the immune system’s response to the destruction and elimination of parasites, bacteria and endotoxins. This process is known as Herxing. 

Common Herxheimer symptoms:

• Bloating
• Brain Fog
• Bright Vision
• Chills
• Constipation
• Cough
• Cramps
• Diarrhea
• Fatigue
• Fever
• Floaters
• Headaches
• Irritability
• Itching
• Joint Pain
• Lethargy
• Mucus
• Muscle Pain
• Nausea
• Runny Nose
• Skin Rash
• Sore Throat
• Stuffy Nose
• Cold Sweats
• Tingling

Herxing typically takes 3-4 months to run its course. If your Herxing symptoms are too much to handle you can reduce the Ivermectin dose, but doing so will only extend the time until you are parasite-free.   

IVERMECTIN TREATMENT 

To treat ALL illness and disease use 1.87% Ivermectin Horse Paste, and/or 1% Ivermectin sterile injection for cow and swine (DO NOT INJECT)
All Ivermectin brands are safe EXCEPT those containing Glycol, or labeled ‘Pour On’.

DOSING

When using the paste, 1 dose = approximately the size of a #2 pencil eraser.

When using the sterile solution,  1 dose = 1 ml per 100 lbs of body weight suspended in 8oz of water or other healthy drink. 

ADULTS

Take 1 dose 2 X a day.

Larger/heavier people can take a larger dose. 

CHILDREN

Take 1/2 a dose once a day for two weeks. Repeat every 6 months. Eliminate all refined sugars, refined carbs, junk food and fast food during the two weeks.

SENIORS and/or ADULTS WITH MAJOR HEALTH PROBLEMS

Use the following protocol to slowly increase tolerance through the first 3 weeks until full adult dosing is reached in week 4.

Week 1 - 1/2 dose a.m. 
Week 2 - 1/2 dose a.m. + p.m. 
Week 3 - 1 dose a.m. + 1/2 p.m. 
Week 4 - 1 dose a.m. + p.m

Tanmoy Das

There are 2 big lies about Type 2 Diabetes :
 1. It's a chronic progressive disease. That's not true. Type 2 Diabetes is a lifestyle and nutritional disorder-it is also a reversible condition and can be put into remission. 
2. Type 2 Diabetes is a disease of high blood sugar. Not true. It's a condition of high insulin levels. 

-Medicines are not the answer. You cannot treat a dietary condition with medicines..bringing down your blood sugar with medicines only means that the sugar has gone to the vital end organs like the kidneys, heart, brain. Over the years, the number of medicines increase and the diabetes gets worse resulting in end organ damage despite of maintaining normal blood sugar with drugs. 

-Access to Diabetes Care and treatment is already out of reach for most. The health care systems are simply not geared to handle the consequences of this disease. Prevention and a dietary approach is the only hope. 

-A life free of diabetes and drugs is possible. A low carbohydrate diet or a very low carbohydrate diet can reverse Type 2 Diabetes and put it into remission. This is very much as per ADA (American Diabetes Association) 2020 Guidelines, which all doctors follow worldwide. 

No one should suffer from from Type 2 Diabetes and its complications. No one.

1. Check nutrient Bioavailability.

6. Any research published using the supplement. (Optional)

11/12/2023, 14:28 - +91 98202 51220: Linoleic acid (the primary fat in seed oils) has multiple fates, with a primary outcome being the production of 4-HNE. This paper (linked below) reinforces the evidence that 4-HNE contributes to metabolic problems, including #insulinresistance, by limiting the ability of subcutaneous fat to proliferate (i.e., make more fat cells; "hyperplasia"). This may seem like a good thing, but by limiting hyperplasia, any pressure for the fat cells to grow must now lead only to hypertrophy (i.e., growth of the cell). Hypertrophic fat cells undergo two important adaptations: 1. They become insulin resistant to prevent further growth (after all, insulin is the primary growth signal on fat cells); 2. They become inflammatory in an effort to increase blood flow to prevent hypoxia ("suffocation of the cell"). These two adaptations, both of which are intended to help the hypertrophic fat cells survive, end up spreading insulin resistance throughout the body. Back to the study: The authors find that even modest elevations in 4-HNE are sufficient to cause these changes. As much as I'm an advocate of eating fat liberally, focus on natural fats: animal fats and fruit fats (e.g., olive, coconut, etc.). 

pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38068967/

https://twitter.com/BenBikmanPhD/status/1733841662961701059?t=PI2D2GGE3trK3m0BQSaBUQ&s=19

14/02/2024, 03:49 - +91 94925 44977: From @drbarbwoegerer

The thyroid cannot function without MAGNESIUM! 
⁠ ⁠⁠
Hypothyroidism and Hashimoto's (autoimmune thyroid condition) are becoming increasingly common. ⁠
⁠
Symptoms can include, fatigue, dry skin, constipation, weight gain, depression, joint pain etc. ⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠
This mineral is one of the most important, and often times deficient nutrients, for those with Hashimoto's.⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
Now you've likely heard of things like iodine, selenium, zinc, tyrosine etc. for the thyroid. One nutrient that often gets overlooked is MAGNESIUM.⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
Some important functions of Magnesium when it comes to our thyroid gland health:⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
💠Magnesium helps to make more T4 in the thyroid gland and without this mineral many of the thyroid enzymes simply could not function.⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
💠Magnesium is responsible for converting the inactive T4 into the active T3. This becomes really important because the metabolism of your body cells are enhanced by T3 and not the inactive T4.⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
💠Magnesium deficiency can also be related to an enlarged thyroid gland (among other things).⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
Magnesium supports adrenal function which is another area that is often compromised for those individuals with a thyroid issue. ⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
Research has shown that Magnesium deficiency can have a direct impact on thyroid function. What was also shown was that physical and psychological stress led to the depletion of Magnesium, which is needed for iodine utilization by the thyroid gland. PMID: 17984925⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
Wang et al. (study) found that a Magnesium deficiency is associated with an increased risk of hypothyroidism and thyroid autoimmunity. PMID: 29967483⁠ ⁠⁠
⁠ ⁠⁠
Other things to include when dealing with hypothyroidism or any autoimmune condition include optimizing gut health, stress reduction, antioxidants & addressing diet and lifestyle factors. It's never just based on one thing! ⁠ ⁠⁠⁠

*What do you need to look for in a Vitamin C supplement?* 
Vitamin C, as it occurs in nature, always appears as a composite of ascorbic acid and certain bioflavonoids. It is this vitamin C complex that is so beneficial, not just ascorbic acid, by itself. 12/04/2024, 11:26 - +91 77966 92506: Neither the physiology of B12 absorption nor any data support using B12 injections over high-dose oral supplements.

Typically in the past, most B12 experts recommended injections over high-dose oral cobalamin for people with pernicious anemia and an advanced deficiency involving neurological symptoms.
However, recent studies have suggested that high-dose oral or nasal administration may be as effective as injections for those with B12 malabsorption problems.
Also, it's very important to know the root cause behind the deficiency. Most of the time it is the imbalance in your gut microbiome or absorption issues that needs to be addressed.

So *it's always best to take the high-dose oral supplement for B12 with other B Vitamins than injections as a long-term B12 deficiency prevention.*👍

07/05/2024, 16:27 - +91 77966 92506: A note on *Iodine Toxicity:*

Too much iodine can be a problem. Chronic iodine intakes over 18,000 mcg/d can cause goiter, just like iodine deficiency. Exposure to grams of iodine at once (one gram is one million micrograms) can cause acute poisoning, involving abdominal pain, fever, nausea, vomiting, and coma.

Some researches show that 200 mcg/d can worsen Hashimoto's thyroiditis and Grave's disease.

The Food and Nutrition Board of the Institute of Medicine, set the upper limit at 1000 mcg/d on the basis that studies have shown two weeks of intakes above this change blood markers of thyroid health. There is no clear evidence of any actual harm at this intake. In fact, some traditional cultures that lived near coastlines and consumed lots of seaweed had intakes as high as 15,000 mcg/d, with no clear evidence of harm. Don't go higher than 15,000 mcg/d unless you have a very strong reason to do so.👍👍

09/05/2024, 11:23 - +91 94925 44977: *Harrison’s Principles of Internal Medicine*, a staple for medical students, has been scrutinized for undisclosed conflicts of interest. A study revealed that from 2009 to 2013, authors received over $11 million from drug and device manufacturers, with one author receiving $870,000, none of which was disclosed in the textbook. Additionally, some authors hold numerous patents, posing further undisclosed conflicts. The study, published in AJOB Empirical Bioethics, suggests that transparency about such conflicts should be standard for medical educational materials. McGraw-Hill, the publisher, has not commented. The researchers, including Brian Piper, argue that while financial ties don’t necessarily indicate bias, they can influence the recommended treatments in textbooks. They advocate for disclosure standards in textbooks similar to those in scientific journals. Until then, medical students should be aware of the potential biases in their textbooks.

*Source* : https://www.statnews.com/2018/03/06/conflict-of-interest-medical-textbook/

*Journal link* - https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/23294515.2018.1436095

For Stainless steel (SS) it's absolutely safer as the outer layer of this steel has "Chromium Oxide" very stable at room /subzero/ elevated temperature like few hundred degree centigrade, meaning nothing leach out during any cooking temperature which is around 100 degree.Entire food processing industries like dairy industries equipment's are made of this Stainless steel from century. During our course many positive points highlighted for Carbon steel utensils stating Iron leaches to food provide Iron to body. But engineering point of view it's not convincing and not safer so we never use cooking having liquid. Only TAWA is used as dry application and frequently cleaned for any rust. As mentioned above, Stainless steel utensils can't contaminate food with Chromium or Molybdenum or Nickel when application temperature is around 100 degree centigrade. That's why Stainless steel material never Rust.  Yes stainless steel is vulnerable to few industrial acids and Chlorides which we don't use in cooking. Finally SS material is safe and backbone of Food processing industries from ages..

23/07/2024, 09:27 - +91 97024 86865: Bone Broth Recipe 

Ingredients:
150 gms of Chicken or Mutton bones 
5 cups of Water
Pink Himalayan Salt as per taste
1 tsp Apple cider vinegar (ACV)

Directions:
Wash the bones well and soak them in ACV with just enough water to submerge them. (The acid in ACV helps pull out more nutrients from bones). Soak for 20 mins.
Transfer this to a large pressure cooker and add water.
Pressure cook on low flame for 15-20 whistles. If you have a crockpot, simmer this for 2-3 hours in the crockpot.
Allow the broth to cool. Strain it into a large container and refrigerate.

You can add all low-fodmap vegetables, herbs, and spices to the broth to enhance the flavor. Common additions include ginger, parsley, thyme, clove, cinnamon, coriander seeds, and star anise. The meat that you procure should be organic, that is, you should look for free-range animals raised without injected hormones, antibiotics, or other chemicals.

19/09/2024, 10:35 - +91 77966 92506: *EAA Protein Bar Recipe*💪

*Ingredients-*
- Stell cut oats- 1 cup
- EAA- 1 sachet
- Dried Fig- 2
- Walnut- 1 (whole)
- Dates- 3
- Desiccated Coconut- 1/4 cup
- Berries- Handful
- Vanilla Extract- 1 tsp
- Cinnamon- 1/4 tsp

*Method:*
1. Roast 1 cup of oats in a pan and then grind it nicely so that we get the oat flour. 
2. Now separately take soaked dried figs, Soaked walnut and soaked dates and blend them to make a paste.
3. Now add this paste to the oat flour and mix it nicely with clean hands
4. Then add EAA, desiccated coconut, chopped berries, vanilla extract and cinnamon powder to it. 
5. A little bit water can be used to make a dough out of it. 
6. Then we can give it any shape of our choice. 
7. Now it's ready to be consumed.

For all those who find difficult to add Unflavoured EAA in their daily life.✨😋 

*A word of caution:* It's high in carbs, so be careful while indulging on it. And avoid giving it to people with severe insulin resistance. <This message was edited>

*The general rule is to go lightly on use of the exclamation mark.* They seem silly unless the writer really means to convey an expression that strongly. 06/10/2024, 14:26 - +91 75739 94551: Fruits and vegetables are often considered alkaline-forming because of their effects on the body's pH after digestion, rather than their inherent acidity or alkalinity. Here's how this works:

1. Organic Acids vs. Alkaline Minerals

Organic Acids: Many fruits (like lemons and oranges) contain organic acids, which can taste sour and are considered acidic when consumed. However, once metabolized, these acids break down and leave behind alkaline residues, primarily in the form of minerals such as potassium, magnesium, and calcium.

Alkaline Minerals: Vegetables typically contain higher levels of alkaline minerals compared to fruits. When consumed, these minerals help to neutralize acids in the body and contribute to a more alkaline environment.


2. Metabolism and Residue Effects

Metabolic Process: The process of digestion and metabolism transforms the food we eat. While some foods may have an acidic pH before consumption, the byproducts of their metabolism can be alkaline. For example, even though citrus fruits are acidic in nature, their metabolic byproducts are alkaline.

Net Acid or Base Effect: The concept of "net acid or base effect" determines whether a food is classified as acid-forming or alkaline-forming. Foods that lead to the production of alkaline byproducts after digestion are categorized as alkaline-forming.


3. Examples of Alkaline-Forming Foods

Fruits: Most fruits, including bananas, melons, apples, and berries, are considered alkaline-forming.

Vegetables: Leafy greens (like spinach and kale), cucumbers, broccoli, and bell peppers are also classified as alkaline-forming.


4. General Classifications

Alkaline-Forming Foods: Typically include most fruits, vegetables, nuts, and seeds.

Acid-Forming Foods: Generally include meat, fish, dairy, eggs, grains, and processed foods.


Conclusion

*The classification of fruits and vegetables as alkaline-forming is based on their metabolic effects rather than their initial pH levels. This distinction is important for understanding how diet may influence body pH and overall health. However, it's essential to remember that the body maintains its pH balance through various regulatory mechanisms, and dietary changes have limited impact on systemic pH levels.*

09/10/2024, 12:35 - +91 94925 44977: In the chart, each nutrient is at optimal status when its bar is full (dark orange). When any or all nutrients are below the optimal level (leaving the lighter orange showing), bone status is impaired at the level of the lowest, or most limited, nutrient.

If one were to focus on optimizing vitamin D, without also optimizing calcium, protein, and magnesium, no change in bone status would be observed, leading to a false conclusion that vitamin D does not affect bone status. 

Even if calcium and vitamin D status are optimized, bone status would improve but would still be limited by the protein status.

Because the nutrients interact in the maintenance of bone health, the effects of a single nutrient may be overlooked if intake of others is not sufficient.

Dr Robert P Heaney

09/10/2024, 16:04 - +91 98481 53986: Here's the comparison:


*Nutritionist* is who:


- Focuses on recommending general dietary guidelines
- Often relies on standardized dietary protocols
- May emphasize calorie counting and macronutrient balance
- Typically addresses symptoms, not underlying causes
- May have a conventional, allopathic approach
- Usually holds a degree in nutrition or a related field
- May be certified by organizations like AND (Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics)


*Functional Nutritionist* is who:


- Takes a holistic, individualized approach to nutrition
- Seeks to identify and address underlying causes of health issues
- Considers genetic, environmental, and lifestyle factors
- Focuses on biochemistry and physiology
- Often uses functional medicine testing (e.g., blood work, stool tests)
- May incorporate alternative therapies (e.g., supplements, mindfulness)
- Typically holds certifications like IFNCP (Integrated Functional Nutrition Certified Practitioner) or FNCP (Functional Nutrition Certified Practitioner)


Key differences:


- Approach: Conventional (nutritionist) vs. Holistic (functional nutritionist)
- Focus: Symptoms (nutritionist) vs. Underlying causes (functional nutritionist)
- Methodology: Standardized protocols (nutritionist) vs. Personalized plans (functional nutritionist)


Your turn! Add your insights:

11/10/2024, 05:58 - +91 94925 44977: The Rules Have Changed 

In the Industrial Age, the rules were to go to school, get good grades, find a safe, secure job with benefits, and stay there all your life. After 20 years or so you retire, and the company and the government take care of you for the rest of your life. 

In the Information Age, the rules have changed. The rules now are to go to school, get good grades, find a job, and then retrain yourself for that job. Find a new company and a new job and retrain. 

Hope and pray you have enough money set aside to last you much longer than age 65 because you will live well beyond the age of sixty-five.

In the Industrial Age, the defining theory of the era was Einstein’s E = mc2. 

In the Information Age, the defining theory of the era is Moore’s law, which spawned the current ideology that the amount of information doubles every 18 months. 

In other words, to keep up with change, you need to virtually relearn everything every 18 months. 

In the Industrial Age, change was slower. 

What you went to school to learn was valuable for a longer period of time. In the Information Age, what you know becomes obsolete very quickly. 

What you learned is important, but not as important as how fast you can learn, change, and adapt to new information.

04/12/2024, 15:53 - Dr Omkar Kulkarni: Learning Functional Nutrition alongside Ayurveda was a transformative experience. Ayurveda offers a holistic perspective deeply rooted in understanding the individual's constitution (Prakriti), while Functional Nutrition emphasizes the biochemical and systemic aspects of health. Combining these two approaches enhanced my ability to address root causes of health issues rather than just managing symptoms.
In Ayurveda most of the diagnostic and therapeutic processes are based on subjective assessments like Nadi (Pulse), Abdominal Examination etc. Now, in the world with such a great technological and diagnostic advances, I found Ayurvedic processes need synergy of modern objective methods. In my clinical practice I have started using pre and post blood biochemistry analysis for Panchakarma procedures (Ayurvedic Detox procedures). Soon I would be able to come up with some strong data on that. 
In practice, integrating Functional Nutrition has refined my recommendations for diet and lifestyle modifications, making them more precise and scientifically aligned while staying true to Ayurvedic principles. For instance, understanding gut health from a functional perspective complements Ayurveda's focus on Agni (digestive fire), enabling me to create more personalized and effective treatment plans. This combination has empowered me to provide comprehensive care that bridges tradition with modern evidence-based approaches, significantly improving outcomes for my patients.

*Mechanisms of Action*
1. Fibrinolytic Activity
Nattokinase exhibits strong fibrinolytic properties, meaning it can dissolve fibrin, a protein involved in blood clot formation. By breaking down excess fibrin in the blood vessels, nattokinase may help improve blood flow and reduce the risk of clot-related complications that can exacerbate venous insufficiency and varicosities.
2. Improvement of Venous Insufficiency
Clinical studies have shown that nattokinase can improve symptoms associated with venous insufficiency, a condition closely linked to the development of varicose veins. In trials involving patients with vascular diseases, including venous insufficiency, those treated with nattokinase reported significant improvements in clinical symptoms without adverse effects. This suggests that nattokinase may help alleviate some of the discomfort associated with varicose veins.
3. Enhanced Circulation
By promoting better blood circulation and reducing blood viscosity, nattokinase may help mitigate the pressure on vein walls. This reduction in pressure can potentially prevent the worsening of varicose veins and improve overall vascular health.
4. Safety Profile
Nattokinase has been found to be well-tolerated in clinical settings, showing no significant adverse reactions when used as a treatment for various vascular conditions. This safety profile makes it a viable option for individuals seeking alternative therapies for managing varicose veins.

"The Sun and the Cave"

"One day the Sun and a Cave struck up a conversation. The Sun had trouble understanding what “dark” meant and the Cave didn’t quite get the hang of “light and clear” so they decided to change places. 

The Cave went up to the Sun and said, “Ah, I see, this is beyond wonderful. Now come down and see where I have been living.” 
The Sun went down to the cave and said, “Gee, I don’t see any difference.”

When the sun went down, it took its light along and even the darkest corners were illuminated. That's why the Sun couldn't see any difference.

29/01/2025, 10:40 - +91 89564 17972: Did you know that overly clean environments might increase the risk of food allergies? 🤒💉 The "hygiene hypothesis" suggests that reduced exposure to diverse microbes, particularly during early childhood 👶🏻, hampers the development of a balanced immune system. This immune imbalance predisposes individuals to allergies and autoimmune diseases 🦠🧫

A study highlights that "early microbial exposure trains the immune system to regulate itself, reducing the risk of allergy development". Limited exposure to beneficial microbes, such as those found in farm environments, reduces this immune training, leading to higher allergy risks.😷

"Children raised in rural environments are exposed to a greater variety of microbes, which reduces allergy incidence compared to urban areas," according to an analysis of rural-urban differences. This finding supports the protective effect of microbial diversity.🌵🐞🛝🏏

The transition to sanitized, urbanized living has drastically reduced natural microbial exposure, leading to what some researchers term the "microbial deprivation hypothesis" 🎮🎲🎳 . Reintroducing "healthy dirt," such as through safe outdoor play or probiotics, could reshape immune responses. 🤸🏻‍♀️

By promoting safe, diverse microbial exposure, like farm visits or consuming fermented foods, we can help restore immune balance and reduce allergy risks. This isn't just about "clean vs. dirty"—it's about finding the right microbial balance for a healthier immune system. 💪🏻🦠

12/02/2025, 16:40 - +91 89563 56280: *Aeronutrition: Can we absorb nutrients from the air we breathe?* 🌱

Emerging research suggests that the human body may absorb certain vitamins and minerals directly from the air through specialized cilia receptors in the respiratory system. This is termed as _aeronutrition_ . Some researchers in Ireland observed that children living near coastal areas🏄‍♀️ had notably higher iodine levels in their urine and were less likely to be iodine deficient. Coastal areas were rich in seaweed and atmospheric iodine levels were higher in those regions.  This observation brings new meaning to the expression " _Sea air is good for you!_ "

Interestingly, our lungs 🫁 can process molecules up to 260 times larger than those absorbed by the gut; Substances inhaled can enter the bloodstream and appear in urine almost immediately. Aerosolized vitamin B12 has even been used in clinical settings to address deficiencies. With an average of 9,000 liters of air inhaled daily 👃, could the air we breathe play a larger role in nutrition than previously thought?🤔

Also, airborne bacteria, known as _aeromicrobes_ , can support the diversity of the respiratory and gut microbiomes. This is especially relevant for people in urban areas or those with limited exposure to natural environments, such as astronauts who spend long periods in highly filtered air, which may lack beneficial microbes and nutrients. Fresh air plays a vital role in human health, highlighting the importance of access to natural environments to support overall well-being.

19/02/2025, 09:46 - +91 89565 35768: Buffered is not always preferred in supplements.
In the context of magnesium specifically , buffered magnesium bisglycinate contains a mix of magnesium bisglycinate and another form of magnesium, typically magnesium oxide.Magnesium oxide increases the total magnesium content in the product, but it is less bioavailable compared to bisglycinate.Buffered versions tend to be less expensive since magnesium oxide is cheaper to produce.

Non-buffered magnesium bisglycinate contains magnesium that is fully chelated (bound) to the amino acid glycine. This chelation enhances its absorption and reduces the risk of gastrointestinal discomfort.
Non-buffered forms are less likely to cause digestive upset, such as diarrhea, as they don't contain other magnesium salts like magnesium oxide.

HRT - estrogen 

Description
The conjugated estrogens are noncrystalline mixtures of purified female sex hormones obtained either by its isolation from the urine of pregnant mares or by synthetic generation from vegetal material. Both of these products are later conjugated to natrium sulfate by ester bonds in order to make them more water soluble. The conjugated estrogen product contains a mix of estrogen from which about 50% is represented by estrone sulfate followed by 25% of equilin sulfate, 15% of 17-alpha-dehydroequilenin sulfate, 3% of equilenin sulfate, 5% of 17-alpha and 17-beta-dihydroequilenin sulfate, 2% of 17-alpha-estradiolsulfate and 3% of 17-beta-estradiolsulfate. It also presents a large number of unidentified molecules with weak estrogenic activity as well as non-human molecules when it is obtained from pregnant mares urine. The conjugated estrogen mixture was approved for marketing in US in 1942 based on the efficacy against certain conditions. However, until 1986 official clinical trials were performed and this product was determined to be effective for the treatment of osteoporosis. The currently approved product of conjugated estrogens was developed by Wyeth Ayerst and FDA approved in 2003.
DrugBank
Estrogens, conjugated is an Estrogen. The mechanism of action of estrogens, conjugated is as an Estrogen Receptor Agonist.
FDA Pharm Classes
Estrogens, Conjugated is purified orally bioavailable female sex hormones isolated from pregnant mare urine or synthetically derived from plant materials and primarily conjugated as sulfate esters. Estrogen binds to and activates specific nuclear receptors, which, in turn, bind to estrogen response elements (EREs) in target genes, resulting in histone acetylation, alteration of chromatin conformation, and initiation of transcription. (NCI04)

BHRT - the progesterone used is exactly the same structure of the one made by the body

24/02/2025, 10:15 - +91 77966 92506: Pruritus (itching) is sometimes a symptom of a disease (e.g., cholestatic liver disease, uremia, lymphoma, or various skin conditions), but in other cases, it is idiopathic. Identifying the root cause of the same is the 1st step in designing the targeted protocol.

For whom the cause is unknown:
1. *Check for food allergies* or intolerances & eliminate inflammatory/triggering foods.
2. *Check for Iron Deficiency:* Iron deficiency can cause atrophic changes of the skin, potentially resulting in pruritus. Pruritus has been found to be significantly more common in people with iron deficiency anemia than in those with normal iron status.
3. *Omega 3s* - 1.5 - 2 gms of combined EPA+DHA helps to get down inflammation.
4. *Magnesium* - Pruritus developed in rats fed a magnesium-deficient diet, possibly as a result of increased release of histamine from mast cells. Consider the Magnesium supplement dosage of *400-600 mg/d.*
5. *Topical Application (Niacinamide)* - In a study presented as an abstract, 19 patients with various pruritic dermatoses experienced rapid and marked improvement of pruritus after the application of an ointment containing 4% niacinamide.

1. *Grapefruit juice:* In case reports, ingestion of *600 ml/day* of grapefruit juice resolved pruritus within 24 to 48 hours in 5 patients with cholestasis due to primary biliary cirrhosis and in 1 patient with cholestasis associated with amoxicillin/ clavulanic acid-induced hepatitis. Pruritus recurred when 
grapefruit juice was discontinued. In contrast, grapefruit juice did not relieve pruritus in 3 patients with chronic hepatitis C without cholestasis. https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/10.7326/0003-4819-125-8-199610150-00032
2. *S-Adenosylmethionine:* SAMe has been reported to relieve pruritus associated with certain types of cholestatic liver disease, including cirrhosis, chronic viral hepatitis, and chronic active hepatitis. The usual recommended dose of SAMe for liver disorders is *1,600 mg/d*. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2188871/
3. *Flavonoids*: In an uncontrolled trial, administration of hydroxyethylrutosides (a mixture of semisynthetic flavonoids) in doses of *250—2,000 mg/d* relieved chronic pruritus in 6 consecutive patients with primary biliary cirrhosis. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7295558/
4. *Vitamin K1* - In an uncontrolled trial, parenteral administration of unspecified doses of phytomenadione (Konakion; a synthetic form of vitamin K,) produced complete or partial remission of pruritus in each of 11 patients with primary biliary cirrhosis or intrahepatic cholestasis. iThrive's D3 with K2 should take care in this case as K2 can be recycled and converted in K1 as needed by the body. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6124800/

24/02/2025, 11:23 - +91 89563 56280: *Carbon Dioxide: The Unsung Hero of Human Physiology* 🤴

Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is often underestimated, yet it plays a vital role in human physiology. A person breathing 30 times a minute (fast breathing) has lower tolerance for CO₂. In contrast, someone breathing 10 times a minute has a higher CO₂ tolerance, reflecting a calmer and more efficient respiratory state. *Faster breathing is a hallmark of stress* and it reduces CO₂ levels in the body

CO₂ and O₂ are like yin and yang, each playing a complementary role. On inhalation, O₂ binds to hemoglobin in the blood and is transported to cells. However, for O₂ to be released into the cells, a signal is needed. This is where CO₂ comes into play - An increase in CO2 lowers the pH (acidic). This acidity signals hemoglobin to change its shape and release O₂ into the cells (Bohr effect). Thus, *oxygen is the thing we need, but carbon dioxide is crucial for efficient oxygenation* .  

O2 is a lifesaver but it is a very reactive molecule. Too much of it, creates free radicals. This is where we use CO2 as a buffer against this - the technique is to breathe slowly so that it *simultaneously limit oxygen availability while raising CO2 levels* . In such a case, more of the O2 is getting inside the tissues due to the pH drop being brought by the increased CO2. *You will become like an efficient car with high gas mileage and will be able to perform more in one breath* . One molecule of oxygen will get more work done compared to when you are breathing faster, taking in more oxygen, and blowing off more CO2, making oxygen utilization less efficient.

To harness the benefits of CO₂, it’s important to regulate your breathing rate. Slower, deeper breaths help increase CO₂ tolerance, improving oxygen delivery and reducing stress. If you’re practicing techniques to increase CO₂ levels, such as controlled breathing, it’s crucial to start slowly and pay close attention to how your body responds. *Gradually building up your CO2 tolerance* ensures safety and allows your body to adapt effectively.  

For more interesting studies: refer to *Anders Olsson*
https://www.consciousbreathing.com/blogs/articles/meet-anders-olsson

01/03/2025, 11:40 - +91 89563 56280: *_How do we define stress?_* 
Hypothalamus is the stress detector in the body. Once triggered, the hypothalamus (brain) recruits the pituitary glands (brain) and adrenals (kidneys) to manage it's response to a stress. This triad is called the *HPA* axis. 

This, anything that triggers the hypothalamus/HPA axis is a stress to the body. 

Stressor (physical/mental/emotional) → triggers hypothalamus → stimulates pituitary gland to release ACTH hormone → hormone signals the adrenals to release *cortisol* → fight/flight response (emergency mode - all other body non-essential body functions paused). This temporary pause of body functions by cortisol looks good in the short-term, but harmful if continued long-term.

Adrenals also release a hormone *DHEA* , that opposes the effects of cortisol & protects the body from its damage. This same DHEA also does other functions like synthesizing estrogen & testosterone. However, the body under a long-term stressor, will get depleted of it's DHEA stores too.  

Some tests to measure cortisol levels are:
1. *Total cortisol output* - overall amount of cortisol produced in a 24 hour cycle (sampling: blood/urine/saliva)
2. *Cortisol Awaking Response (CAR)* - the morning cortisol surge within 30 minutes of waking up. (sampling: saliva)
3. *Cortisol Diurnal Rhythm* - how cortisol levels vary throughout the day (sampling: saliva)

The results can indicate normal cortisol levels or high cortisol levels (hypercortisolism) or low cortisol levels (hypocortisolism).

However to determine if a person's HPA axis if dysfunctional or not, cortisol levels alone aren't sufficient. Here, the *cortisol:DHEA* ratio is more useful than the cortisol levels alone.

Outlining 5 out of 8 reported cases below:

Case 1: A 63-year-old woman’s  ALT decreased from 1897U/L to 35U/L after discontinuation of Herbalife product. Re-introduction of Herablife product caused ALT to rise till 758 U/L.

Case 4: A 39-yr old woman was on Herbalife products. She experienced hepatitis, which improved after stopping the use of Herbalife products.

Case 5: A 49-yr old woman used Herbalife products and experienced an ALT of 922 U/L. Once the product use was stopped, the values dropped to 793 U/L and rose to 1500 U/L after re-introduction of the product.
05/03/2025, 15:01 - +91 89563 56280: A Heavy Price for Weight Loss Supplements: Herbalife Related Acute Hepatitis- American Journal of Gastroenterology
https://journals.lww.com/ajg/fulltext/2012/10001/a_heavy_price_for_weight_loss_supplements_.1094.aspx	

"Herbalife weight loss supplements have been widely sold in many countries since 1980. There have been about 40 cases of acute liver injury since 2007 related to Herbalife reported from 5 different countries. The component responsible and the mechanism of liver damage is not clear but there is a report suggesting hepatotoxicity due to contamination with Bacillus subtilis. The mainstay of treatment is discontinuation of Herbalife and empiric treatment with steroids and/or N-acetyl cysteine. The prognosis is variable with most patients improving but in some patients the disease progresses even after discontinuation of Herbalife and possible death. Our case report probably represents only the tip of the iceberg related to Herbalife induced liver damage. More research in the safety of these supplements is needed to prevent fatal outcomes."
05/03/2025, 15:03 - +91 89563 56280: Slimming at all costs: Herbalife®-induced liver injury (Journal of Hepatology)

"Two case report series from Israel and Switzerland for the first time describe incidents of severe liver injury along with the intake of a panel of different Herbalife® products. Herbalife sells nutritional and herbal supplements for weight control, improvement of nutrition, and “well-being”, and cosmetics online or through independently operating sales agents. Among the 22 cases of liver damage following Herbalife intake analyzed in the two reports, two patients developed fulminant hepatic failure requiring super urgent liver transplantation which saved one patient’s life while the second died due to postoperative complications. Causality between the intake of Herbalife® products and the evolution of liver injury was carefully assessed by internationally accepted causality scores. In five patients, causality was labelled “certain” by a positive re-challenge reaction and “probable” in additional 13 patients." <This message was edited>

09/03/2025, 21:51 - +91 83698 18543: A woman who received an advanced cancer treatment 18 years ago is still cancer-free. She has not needed any more treatment since then, showing that this therapy could lead to long-term survival or even a cure.  

She was treated as a child for neuroblastoma, a rare and aggressive nerve cancer, using CAR T-cell therapy. This treatment involves taking a patient’s immune cells, modifying them to attack cancer, and returning them to the body. While CAR T-cell therapy has worked well for blood cancers, its success with solid tumors has been less certain. However, her case proves it can lead to long-lasting remission, even when the cancer is still spreading.  

She was part of a clinical trial between 2004 and 2009, when CAR T-cell therapy was still new. Despite her cancer being active, she fully recovered and remains the longest-known survivor of this treatment for a solid tumor. This suggests the therapy may not only destroy cancer but also prevent it from returning. Scientists believe that the modified T-cells continue to stay in the body, ready to fight off any new cancer cells, offering long-term protection.

13/03/2025, 13:31 - +91 77966 92506: *EAA Protein Bar Recipe*💪

*Ingredients-*
- Stell cut oats- 1 cup
- EAA- 1 sachet
- Dried Fig- 2
- Walnut- 1 (whole)
- Dates- 3
- Desiccated Coconut- 1/4 cup
- Berries- Handful
- Vanilla Extract- 1 tsp
- Cinnamon- 1/4 tsp

*Method:*
1. Roast 1 cup of oats in a pan and then grind it nicely so that we get the oat flour. 
2. Now separately take soaked dried figs, Soaked walnut and soaked dates and blend them to make a paste.
3. Now add this paste to the oat flour and mix it nicely with clean hands
4. Then add EAA, desiccated coconut, chopped berries, vanilla extract and cinnamon powder to it. 
5. A little bit water can be used to make a dough out of it. 
6. Then we can give it any shape of our choice. 
7. Now it's ready to be consumed.

For all those who find difficult to add Unflavoured EAA in their daily life.✨😋 

*A word of caution:* It's high in carbs, so be careful while indulging on it. And avoid giving it to people with severe insulin resistance.

22/03/2025, 15:15 - +91 89563 56280: Answer:
_All of the above are stressors that can activate the HPA axis._ 
Below is a breakdown of how each of them can act as a stressor:

*1. Giving a welcome speech*: For most people, events like public speaking trigger the hypothalamus. How easily a mental and emotional stressor can trigger hypothalamus? → depends on if it's a new experience to that individual; if the person feels a sense of loss of control; if it feels like a threat to their own ego-identity and if the event is unpredictable in nature.

*2. Binge-watching and late sleep*: Disturbed sleep is a stressor to the body since it has lost its essential down-time. This type of stressor activates HPA axis & cortisol is released, to compensate for the lost repair-time. Cortisol keeps the body in a "fight-or-flight" mode and leads to fragmented/shallow/broken sleep. A quickshort nap in the day-time can be a great relief.

*3. Skipping breakfast after overnight fasting* : Prolonged fasting lowers the blood sugar levels. This is a metabolic stressor that activates the HPA axis. Hence, cortisol is released to bring up the glucose levels in blood. If this is continued over time, it leads to insulin resistance, obesity, cardiovascular diseases etc.

*4. Suffering from food allergies* : Any type of inflammation is a stressor to the body and it releases cortisol. Cortisol (suppresses the immune system) is like a band-aid for the body to combat inflammation. However continued inflammation will elevate cortisol levels and cause damage to the body.

*5. Living with abusive relatives* : Any kind of psychological stressor activates HPA axis and cortisol is released to cope with the situations. A toxic environment keeps the body in a constant state of emergency mode. Prolonged time in such an environment drains the cortisol reserves and causes HPA dysfunction.

24/03/2025, 09:33 - +91 88501 25472: *Good morning everyone,*

I truly appreciate this discussion on **ego, salvation, and spiritual growth**. It’s always valuable to explore different perspectives with an open mind, as we all seek truth and deeper connection with the Divine.  

*Is Ego Always Bad?* 
Sanatan Dharma teaches that ego (अहंकार) is a barrier to salvation. The Bible also warns against **destructive pride** but acknowledges the value of a **healthy sense of self-worth** rooted in our divine nature.  

1. **The Danger of Prideful Ego:**  
   - *"Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall."* (Proverbs 16:18, KJV)  
   - *"God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble."* (James 4:6, KJV)  
   - Just as the Bhagavad Gita warns against arrogance, the Bible teaches that **self-exaltation blinds us from truth and spiritual growth**.  

2. **The Necessity of Good Ego – Recognizing Our Divine Nature & Worth**  
   While prideful ego leads to separation from God, a **healthy ego is essential for understanding our worth and fulfilling our divine purpose**.  

   - *"I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made."* (Psalm 139:14, KJV)  
   - *"I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me."* (Philippians 4:13, KJV)  
   - *"Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven."* (Matthew 5:16, KJV)  

   Good ego helps us:  
   ✅ Recognize that we are created with value and purpose.  
   ✅ Understand our divine identity rather than live in self-doubt.  
   ✅ Step into our highest potential, not for selfish gain but for the greater good.  

   I understand that Mukta is also expressing this, where one realizes their spiritual nature. It’s important to engage with these ideas with an open mind and heart.  

---

### **Scientific Proof: The Role of Self-Worth in Spiritual Growth**  
Modern psychology supports the Biblical truth that **a healthy sense of self-worth leads to transformation**.  

🔬 **Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs** (1943) – A Psychological Theory  
Abraham Maslow, a well-known psychologist, developed a theory stating that humans **must first develop a strong sense of self-worth before they can pursue higher spiritual experiences**. His hierarchy includes:  
1️⃣ **Basic Needs** – Food, water, shelter  
2️⃣ **Psychological Needs** – Love, belonging, and self-esteem (good ego)  
3️⃣ **Self-Actualization** – Spiritual enlightenment and fulfillment  

Biblical Connection:  
- Jesus emphasized **first knowing our value** before spiritual growth:  
  *"Love your neighbor as yourself."* (Mark 12:31, KJV) – Meaning we must **first recognize our worth in God’s eyes** before we can love others.  
- **If we hate ourselves or believe we are worthless, we cannot progress spiritually.**  

Thus, **good ego (self-worth) is necessary** to elevate one’s consciousness, which aligns with both **psychology and Biblical wisdom**.  

---

*Salvation and Redemption – The Essence of Christ* 
Many spiritual traditions emphasize different paths to divine connection, just as one can reach Delhi by train, road, or air. However, the Bible teaches that **salvation is not about striving but about receiving redemption through Christ**:  

- *"For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved."* (John 3:17, KJV)  
- *"In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace."* (Ephesians 1:7, KJV)  
- True salvation in Christ **is not about condemnation but about transformation and reconciliation with God**.  

This is where the message of Christ differs—**it offers redemption as a free gift**, not something we achieve by eliminating ego or mind but by surrendering to divine grace.  

---

*The Threefold Nature of Man: A Biblical Perspective*  
Sanatan Dharma speaks of **the gross body, subtle body, and atma (soul)**. The Bible presents a similar structure but with a different ultimate goal:  

1. **Body (Material, Perishable)**  
   - *"And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life."* (Genesis 2:7, KJV)  

2. **Soul (Mind, Will, and Emotions – Needs Renewal)**  
   - *"Be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind."* (Romans 12:2, KJV)  

3. **Spirit (Eternal, Can Be Reconciled to God)**  
   - *"Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it."* (Ecclesiastes 12:7, KJV)  

Unlike Moksha, which dissolves individuality, **salvation in Christ restores our identity in perfect union with God**.  

---

Final Thought – An Invitation to Explore  
Many consider the Bhagavad Gita as a foundation for spiritual wisdom, followed by deeper studies like Srimad Bhagavatam. Similarly, the Bible invites seekers to explore **Jesus’ words in the Gospel of John** as the ultimate revelation of divine truth:  

- *"God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets, Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son."* (Hebrews 1:1-2, KJV)  
- *"I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last."* (Revelation 22:13, KJV)  

I encourage everyone to **read the Gospel of John with an open heart**, just as we would explore any sacred text, and share your thoughts.  

Blessings to all!

26/03/2025, 14:33 - +91 89563 56280: *Aluminum in vaccines*
Aluminum in vaccines is a serious concern since it interferes with two critical systems in the body: (1) Glutathione and (2) DHPR-BH4 pathway. 

1. *Glutathione* is the body’s master detoxifier - it binds to toxins like arsenic and helps remove them. But aluminum slows glutathione down, making it harder for the body to clear out other dangerous metals and chemicals. This means aluminum doesn’t just sit there harmlessly; it weakens our natural defenses, allowing toxins to build up and accumulate in the body.  

2. *DHPR (Dihydropteridine Reductase)* gene produces *BH4 (tetrahydrobipterin)* - a key molecule for making neurotransmitters like dopamine and serotonin. Aluminum slows DHPR down, reducing BH4 levels and disrupting brain chemistry. This can harm mood, focus, and also heart health, since BH4 also supports nitric oxide production. <This message was edited>

29/03/2025, 11:32 - +91 89563 56280: *Exciting Discovery – Lungs Play a Surprising Role in Blood Production* 🫁🩸

While we’ve long thought that platelets (cells that help blood clot) are mainly made in bone marrow, new research shows the lungs are actually a major production site too. Scientists found that large cells called megakaryocytes travel from the bone marrow to the lungs, where they release huge numbers of platelets—about half of the body’s total supply.

More surprisingly, they even found that the lungs have their own reserve of platelet-making cells and stem cells. In cases where bone marrow is low on stem cells, like after blood loss, these lung-based cells can migrate out, repopulate the marrow, and help restore platelet levels. Thus, lungs act as a back up and help the body respond to emergencies, like sudden blood loss.

This reveals the lungs as a key player in blood cell production and repair. It’s amazing how much we’re still learning about the body’s interconnected systems. 

Also, the ancient wisdom that quoted ‘breath/prana is life’ takes on new meaning with this recent discovery.

Geographic tongue, also known as benign migratory glossitis, is a harmless, noncancerous inflammatory condition that causes red, map-like patches to appear on the tongue. 31/03/2025, 10:35 - +91 77966 92506: Geographic tongue's exact cause is not well understood, but it is believed to be linked to various factors, including *genetic predisposition, nutritional deficiencies, immune system irregularities, and lifestyle factors*. Understanding these triggers is crucial for managing geographic tongue. Identifying and addressing root causes can lead to significant symptom improvements.

1. *Food allergy:* Geographic tongue is frequently observed in people with allergic conditions. In one study, 48% of 126 patients with asthma and/or rhinitis had geographic tongue, compared with 19% of healthy controls (p < 0.01). In most cases, geographic tongue resolves after they identify and avoid allergenic foods, and recurs if the offending foods are eaten.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6592509/  

2. *Zinc:* Of 25 patients with symptomatic geographic tongue, 21 (84%) had marginally low serum zinc concentrations. Of 12 patients with low serum zinc who took 45 mg of zinc (as zinc sulfate) 3 times per day, 10 (83%) became asymptomatic, with complete resolution of the geographic tongue occurring in 4 cases. Long-term zinc supplementation should be accompanied by a copper supplement (1-4 mg/day, depending on the zinc dose), in order to prevent zinc-induced copper deficiency.

3. *B Vitamins:* Glossitis is common in patients who are deficient in vitamin B12, B9, B6 & B2 and correction of these deficiencies results in improvement or resolution of glossitis. It is common for people who are deficient in one B vitamin to be deficient in others as well. Therefore, individuals with glossitis suspected to be due to B-vitamin deficiency should, in most cases, be treated with the entire vitamin B complex.
https://www.banglajol.info/index.php/UpDCJ/article/download/76995/50578/211033

4. *Other essential nutrients:* Mg, Vitamin D3 with K2 & Omega 3 fatty acids to manage the inflammation. <This message was edited>

02/04/2025, 10:25 - +91 89565 35768: *This is how much Vitamin B12 is absorbed & how based on above paper :* 

*Primary absorption site:*

The small intestine (mainly the ileum) is where most Vitamin B12 is absorbed, not the colon.

The colon has limited absorption (<1%) since it lacks Intrinsic Factor (IF), a protein essential for efficient B12 uptake.

*Absorption Efficiency Based on Dose:*

1 µg dietary B12 → ~50% absorbed (0.5 µg enters bloodstream)

5 µg dietary B12 → ~30% absorbed (1.5 µg enters bloodstream)

10 µg dietary B12 → ~20% absorbed (2.0 µg absorbed)

25 µg dietary B12 → ~10–15% absorbed

500 µg (high-dose supplement) → ~1% absorbed (~5 µg enters bloodstream)

1,000 µg (1 mg) supplement → ~1% absorbed (~10 µg enters bloodstream)

*Why Colon Absorption is Limited:*

Some bacteria in the colon produce B12, but the human body cannot efficiently absorb it because there is no Intrinsic Factor in the colon.

Colonic absorption efficiency is <1% of dietary intake, meaning it is not a reliable source of B12. <This message was edited>
02/04/2025, 10:27 - +91 89565 35768: *Factors Reducing B12 Absorption:*

Low stomach acid (hypochlorhydria or atrophic gastritis) → reduces B12 release from food.

Pernicious anemia (Intrinsic Factor deficiency) → causes severe malabsorption.

Gastrointestinal conditions (Crohn’s disease, celiac disease, IBS) → reduce absorption.

Bariatric surgery (gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy) → 80–90% reduction in B12 absorption.

Acid-reducing medications (proton pump inhibitors, H2 blockers) → can decrease absorption by 60–70%.

02/04/2025, 13:51 - +91 89563 56280: *High Fructose Consumption in a Magnesium-deficient Body Induces Insulin Resistance*

The rise in fructose consumption from processed foods and sugary beverages coincides with widespread magnesium deficiency. When combined, these factors disrupt metabolic health, leading to insulin resistance.

A critical mechanism involves reduced *paraoxonase enzyme* activity. 

Paraoxonase enzyme:
1. Enhances glucose uptake by increasing *GLUT4 expression* in skeletal muscle, which is essential for blood sugar regulation. 
2. Additionally, paraoxonase enzyme *detoxifies organophosphate residues* found in wheat and corn. 

Interestingly, individuals with type 2 diabetes (T2D) often exhibit low paraoxonase enzyme activity, further linking it to insulin resistance.

*Animal studies confirm this interaction:*
1. Rats fed high-fructose diets develop insulin resistance.
2. *Magnesium supplementation* reverses this effect, indicating that magnesium deficiency - not fructose alone - drives metabolic dysfunction

*Key Takeaways* :

1. Magnesium deficiency, rather than fructose itself, is the primary driver of insulin resistance in skeletal muscle & associated changes in blood pressure. The deficiency further exacerbates the harmful cycle of metabolic disruption. 

2. Ensuring adequate magnesium intake - particularly if you are an ardent fan of high-processed-food diets - will help restore insulin sensitivity and support detoxification pathways, offering a practical way to keep insulin resistance at bay.

05/04/2025, 14:01 - +91 89563 56280: If you’ve ever searched online for ways to reduce stress or improve focus, you’ve probably seen *binaural beats* - those steady tones on YouTube that claim to help with sleep, mood, or concentration. Though they might seem like just another trend, there’s real science behind them.

*Here’s how it works:* 
If you play two tones that are slightly different - like 200 Hz in one ear and 210 Hz in the other- the brain's auditory center combines them & creates the illusion of a third, rhythmic pulse: a 10 Hz beat - called a binaural tone. 

This binaural tone can be heard or felt in the head, or between the ears. 

This effect only works if the original tones are below 1000 Hz and the difference between both the tones should be within 1–30 Hz. 

For example, 400 Hz in one ear and 420 Hz in the other produces a 20 Hz beat perceived as a gentle throb "inside the head". 

Our brain’s natural rhythms vary depending on our mental state:

Delta (0.5–4 Hz): Deep sleep.
Theta (4–8 Hz): Light sleep, meditation.
Alpha (8–13 Hz): Relaxation.
Beta (13–30 Hz): Focus.
Gamma (30–50 Hz): Complex thinking.

When listening to binaural beats over time, the brain naturally synchronizes its brainwaves to match the frequency of the beat. This process is called *brainwave entrainment*. It allows us to guide brain activity toward specific states - like relaxation (alpha waves), focus (beta waves), or deep sleep (delta waves) - by choosing the corresponding binaural frequency. 

*How to listen?*

Pick a playlist of binaural beats from YouTube. Wear headphones and choose a quiet environment. Play the track, relax, and let your brain adjust to the rhythm. Consistency and minimal distractions improve results.

09/04/2025, 13:39 - +91 89563 56280: Interesting question!! @919632259626 

When we’re feeling useless, lousy or 'I don't want to move even a finger' kinda state, it is our *Default Mode Network* that is in action. Typically active during rest, the DMN supports creativity and introspection. However, if the DMN is too active,

* We dwell on perceived failures ("I’m useless").
* We catastrophize ("Nothing will ever change").
* We get trapped in mental loops (replaying mistakes or regrets).
* Our brain prioritizes self-judgment over problem-solving.

Excessive theta, alpha or delta brainwaves are seen in such an overactive default mode.

➡️When we are engaged in replaying past mistakes and stuck in self-critical thoughts ("Why am I like this?") or worrying about the future, etc.→ *excessive theta wave* (4-7 Hz) activity occurs in the brain.

➡️When we stare blankly out a window,  where the mind drifts without clear focus, it leads to detached introspection (not always negative) →  *excessive alpha waves* (8-12 Hz) activity occurs in the brain.

➡️When you are in extreme mental fatigue/burnout, *delta waves* (0.5-3 Hz)waves occur in the brain. Delta waves (0.5-3 Hz) are meant to occur during deep sleep and if it occurs *while awake* , it can mean severe depression. 

*How to get out of this loop?*

* *Increasing the beta brainwave* (13-30 Hz) -linked to focused tasks and problem-solving- is the antidote. Engaging in mildly challenging mental exercises—counting backward from 100 by threes, solving puzzles, or _listening to binaural beats_ in the beta frequency range—can shift the brain into a more alert, present-oriented state. 

* *Disrupting theta/alpha* by engaging in physical movement like washing dishes, stretching, walking etc. This helps to anchor the mind to the present moment. 

* *Using external focus* - naming the objects around you - forces the brain into a present-moment, non-DMN mode. <This message was edited>

09/04/2025, 16:57 - +91 77966 92506: Psoriasis is a chronic, recurring skin condition characterized by raised, inflamed, scaly, pruritic lesions covered 
with a silvery-white scale.

Nutritional Supplements that can help:
1. *High Dose Folinic Acid with Vitamin C (1000 mg/d)* - 2 practitioners treated psoriasis using high-dose folic acid (50-100 mg/d). Taper after the maximum level of improvement is achieved. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/884959/
With what we know now that Folinic Acid is more bioavailable than folic acid, one should use OTC Leucovorin 15 mg. The available evidence suggests that high-dose folic acid therapy may be inappropriate for psoriasis patients who are receiving, or have previously been treated with, methotrexate.
2. *Omega 3 Fatty Acids* - Leukotriene B4, a lipoxygenation product of arachidonic acid, appears to be involved in the pathogenesis of psoriasis. The formation of leukotriene B4, can be inhibited by replacing arachidonic acid in phospholipids with eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), which is present in high concentrations in fish/cod liver oil. EPA is converted to leukotriene B5, which has lower biologic activity than leukotriene B4. Several open and double-blind trials have reported beneficial effects of fish oil supplementation in doses ranging from *10 to 45 g/day for periods of 6 weeks to 4 months.*
3. *Vitamin D3* - 2500 - 5000 IU/d
4. *Chromium (If the person also has insulin resistance)* - 600 mcg/d
5. *Inositol for lithium-induced psoriasis:* In a double blind trial, supplementation with inositol 6 gm/d decreased the severity of lithium-induced psoriasis, but did not improve psoriasis in people not taking lithium.
6. *Sunflower Lecithin (15-45 gm/d)* is beneficial
7. *Vitamin A*, if low.
8. Probiotics with prebiotics: Probiotics with species L. Paracasei, L. Pentosus, L. Salivarius, B. Infantis, S. Boulardii & L. Rhamnosus are highly effective in reducing flare-ups & clearing the skin. Complementing with prebiotic fiber such as inulin, acacia Senegal, and pectin can accelerate healing
9. *Other Essential Nutrients* - Mg, Zinc & B Complex

Herbs that may help:
1. Feverfew (100-150 mg/d for 4 months)
2. Reishi Mushroom

13/04/2025, 15:45 - +91 98203 97949: The Kangen water filters produced by Enagic are granulated activated carbon (called GAC) with much large pores that allow more things to get trough. It really only removes debris and solid impurities. But things like heavy metals, fluoride, chlorine, chloramine, THMs, DBPs, and other compounds, all make it through into the water.

In other words, if your tap water contains toxic heavy metals, then your Kangen Water will still contain toxic heavy metals. According to Enagic the Kangen machine’s manufacturer, under filter specifications (buried in the fine print on on the page) it says: “Elements not removable – Metallic ions and/or salinity present in the original tap water.”

In water, heavy metals such as mercury and lead show up as metallic ions. If you live in an older home with lead in the pipes, and own a Kangen machine, you need to get the additional heavy metal filters for it.

And well-water hardness or salt in the water is not only removed, but can be additionally concerning, because the ionization process turns salt (sodium chloride) into chlorine! And if you purchase Enagic’s additional electrolysis enhancer, which is a chemical salt solution used to make stronger Kangen water, it further increases the salt, chlorine, and calcium residue that build up in the machine and in the water. For this reason, Kangen recommends buying separate citric acid cleansing cartridges to remove the buildup.

So, in short, Kangen machines by themselves are not effective filters, which is why most Kangen sales reps suggest investing in a pre-filter, which is a separate tool you have to purchase in addition to the already overpriced Kangen, to filter the water even before it gets to the Kangen filter.
13/04/2025, 15:45 - +91 98203 97949: Many Kangen representatives claim that their water is structured because it has an ionic charge.

But the fact is, ionic charge does NOT equal molecular structure.

Water crystallography is all about the strength of the hydrogen bonds. And the whole process of electrolysis breaks apart those hydrogen bonds, separating the hydrogen. So, by definition, it couldn’t possibly be structuring the water! It literally rips the structure apart as it separates the molecules.

Dr. Marcel Vogel, an IBM scientist and one of the most renown and prolific water crystallographers, had this to say about it:

"Ionization of water can either occur through structuring the water…or by electrical hydrolysis… When the water is electrically ionized…the existing bonds in the water are torn apart… This process of ionization…creates water with an electrical charge, but with no structural charge. It does not have the structural information.” And Dr. Carly Nuday talks about this phenomenon a bit as well.

In other words, structured water may have a negative charge. And alkalized ionized water may have a negative charge. But this does not mean that the ionized water is structured. Make sense? The electrical current DOES cause water molecules to all align in the direction of the electric current, but there’s no cohesion and connection, so the overall degree of structure in the water is reduced, even though there’s alignment.

Many representatives are aware that the water is not structured. And so they recommend getting a water structurer to use after the Kangen machine. Again, another separate product to buy in addition to the machine itself to do what the machine can’t do.
13/04/2025, 15:45 - +91 98203 97949: Kangen machines ionize water through an electrolysis process that basically electrocutes the water. Whereas nature uses dissolved minerals and weak electromagnetic fields such as geomagnetism for its ionization, such as geomagnetism, the Kangen uses strong manmade AC electrical currents. But unfortunately this ionization method isn’t very stable, in other words the water doesn’t hold its charge for more than a few hours.

Not only does Kangen not remineralize the water, but depending on the TDS or total dissolved solids of the source water going into the machine, any alkaline minerals that enter it end up as hydroxides attached to the OH negative ion. The body doesn’t recognize these compounds. So if your kidneys are functioning well, you will just pee them out. But if not, they could end up as arterial plaque or as mineral deposits in joints and tissues.
13/04/2025, 15:45 - +91 98203 97949: The Kangen machine suffuses water with hydrogen at a concentration of .4 to .9 miligrams/L or parts per million. I’ve read some sources that say the concentration in ERW is up to 1ppm.

And because the method it uses it electrolysis, the hydrogen is very unstable and evaporates quickly. So you have to drink the water quickly after pouring, to get the therapeutic effects.

The TDS of source water is an important consideration with Kangen in general, because if the water is too hard it clogs the machine rather quickly, causing it to produce far less hydrogen.

Whereas, if the source water is too soft, there’s not enough reaction for it to create the right doses of hydrogen. The tap water going into the machine has to have a TDS of at least 100ppm to facilitate enough hydrogen in the final water for it to have any beneficial effect.

As a quick sidenote, there’s more than one kind of Hydrogen. Deuterium is a heavy isotope of hydrogen, which (because it has an extra neutron) isn’t as easily converted into cellular energy as light protium hydrogen, which only has 1 neutron.

So, because the Kangen method uses electrolysis, it can sometimes result in water that’s heavy in deuterium hydrogen, depending on the quality of the cathodes, and on the ratio of the deuterium content of the source water. Because the ionization process frees the hydrogen that’s already in the water, so it would maintain its proportions if the cathodes are in good shape, or donate extra neutrons and increase the deuterium if they’re not. Tap water generally has a deuterium content of around 150-157 parts per million.
